verdict.rationale: The only API evidence is a crawl note saying Wave's developer portal at developer.waveapps.com is the documented home of its GraphQL API. That portal returned 403, so none of its content could be quoted, and Wave's marketing pages document no API. The probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI paths also returned 404. So an official API appears to exist, but its scope, auth, coverage and suitability for agents are unverified. Missing for 10: quotable API reference documentation, auth/scopes details, endpoint coverage of core accounting/invoicing objects, machine-readable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Wave's developer portal (developer.waveapps.com, the documented home of its GraphQL API)
